response.sql: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) as race_avg_wins FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_avg_wins) as country_avg_wins FROM race_averages GROUP BY country), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(country_avg_wins) as overall_average FROM country_averages), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.country_avg_wins FROM country_averages ca CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ca.country_avg_wins > oa.overall_average), above_group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(country_avg_wins) as above_average_group_mean FROM above_overall), final_results AS (SELECT ao.country, ao.country_avg_wins, oa.overall_average, ao.country_avg_wins - oa.overall_average as above_overall_diff, aga.above_average_group_mean, ao.country_avg_wins - aga.above_average_group_mean as above_group_diff FROM above_overall ao CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa CROSS JOIN above_group_avg aga WHERE ao.country_avg_wins > aga.above_average_group_mean) SELECT country, country_avg_wins, above_overall_diff, above_group_diff FROM final_results ORDER BY country_avg_wins DESC
